rdfs:label: context
rdfs:comment: The context within which the object exists or to which it relates — typically a conversation thread.
notes: AS2 deliberately leaves `context` open-ended (a project, event, or conversation). By fediverse convention (FEP-7888), replies in one thread share the same `context` IRI, independent of `inReplyTo` chains; ActivityPub itself does not require this. Distinct from JSON-LD's `@context` (a syntactic keyword). The value is typically the IRI of the root post or a synthetic conversation resource.

history.note: Notes: thread grouping is a fediverse convention (FEP-7888), not an ActivityPub requirement; added FEP-7888 seeAlso.
